note: Hilbert's tenth problem itself was posed in 1900. The Wikipedia article discusses extensions to algebraic number fields (particularly work by Denef, Lipschitz, Shapiro, and Shlapentokh) but does not identify a specific originator or date for when the question of determining which number fields satisfy the problem was first posed. It appears to be a natural generalization of the original 1900 problem rather than a formally posed separate problem with a documented origin date.
